budget_items.what_was_recorded: Warrant #20-14 dated 10/15/2013 was listed with a total; no vote on the warrant is recorded.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Renewal contract provides $2500 each December 1 paid into a deferred compensation plan for the Town Manager.
budget_items.quote: there will be $2500 paid in a deferred compensation plan to the town manager
